title: Versal base change gives smoothness of the 2-fibre product
author: The Stacks Project Authors
source_version: Stacks Project git a04446e57ec1 (2026-07-28); file artin.tex; corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: Represents Z and reduces to an etale chart W -> Z at w_0; in deformation categories the square F_W -> F_Z -> F_V over F_U is a fibre product (fibre-product lemma), the right vertical arrow is smooth by versality of x at u_0 transferred along l/k (versal-change-of-field), the left vertical is smooth since Z -> V x_S U is lft and F_W -> F_Z is smooth (formally-smooth-on-deformation-categories), and the composite F_W -> F_V is smooth by the two-of-three property; the lifting-along-Artinian lemma converts this into smoothness of W -> V at w_0.
